thread:
noah: sketching an alternative take on gateway prewarm: make leases adaptive and telemetry-driven, not just a static hint. goal: reduce cold p99 for short reads while limiting cost / abuse.
yasmin: interesting. what do you mean by adaptive?
enhan: (typo) ethan: e.g., gateway issues short lease, measures prewarm hit success and latency delta, then tunes per-route accept probability and per-tenant concurrency. high hit-rate routes get more permissive, low hit-rate routes get throttled automatically.
vera: love the idea. but we need deterministic safety rules: by default prewarm allowed only for safe methods; non-safe requires explicit opt-in in route config and an idempotency token.
noah: agreed. also propose lease attestation: gateway signs lease id with internal key and returns `x-rw-lease: id` plus `x-rw-lease-sig: <sig>` so upstream can verify lease provenance. helps prevent header forging if we accidentally forward external headers.
yasmin: good call. security aside, we need clear billing semantics. suggest: Hosted treats prewarm as non-billable until we prove unit-cost stability; Dedicated gets opt-in billing. include metric labels for tenant.
ethan: here's a minimal header set to standardize: `x-rw-prefetch: 1
x-rw-lease-id: abc123
x-rw-lease-sig: sha256:<base64>`
vera: and a tiny YAML for platform config: `ingress: prewarm: enabled: true default_mode: safe adaptive: true routes: - prefix: /v1/fast methods: [GET] max_concurrent_per_tenant: 3`
noah: telemetry we must emit so adaptive control works: `prewarm.attempts`, `prewarm.accepts`, `prewarm.hits`, `prewarm.miss_latency_delta_ms`, `prewarm.memory_delta_bytes`, all with tags route=/v1/fast tenant=acme`. keep histograms and counters.
yasmin: operational safety: circuit breaker when upstream CPU or mem crosses threshold -> reject prewarm early. also surface `prewarm.reject_reason` tag (quota|circuit|adaptive).
ethan: hedging interaction: if client hedges, we bind lease to a single inflight attempt. rule: first lease-claim timestamp wins; others receive `x-rw-prefetch-status: joined|ignored`. lease TTL short (~300-600ms). client can explicitly renew by sending `x-rw-lease-renew: 1` before TTL expiry.
vera: streaming endpoints nuance: if prewarm applied before stream open, include initial metadata `prefetch-status: applied`; if applied mid-stream, emit trailer `prefetch-applied: yes;cost_ms=...`. that lets clients adapt backpressure and early reads.
noah: cost modeling note: infra should simulate amplification vector: attacker sends many intents -> upstream conn churn and memory delta. prio: build a load test that fuzzes intents and measure cpu/mem/conn. prio metric: prewarm_cost_per_success_ms.
yi ci-bot: canary report: prewarm-adaptive trial rolled to 10% on /v1/fast; cold p95 -95ms, prewarm.accepts 22%, prewarm.hits 68%, prewarm.reject_reason=circuit 0.8%.
yasmin: action items: noah to draft RFC w/ lease attestation and telemetry signals, vera to write hedging + streaming trailer examples, ethan to build amplification load test and model quota defaults. i'll coordinate a 3-week canary.
noah: RFC name: "adaptive ingress prewarm leases (attested)". aiming for draft by next Wed.
ci-bot: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/r/4122-adaptive-prefetch-leases
noah: moving to RFC review. thanks all :thumbsup:
